title: GCOM-W (AMSR2 mounted): AMSR2 Specifications

excerpts.locator: AMSR2 Specifications: Scan and rate; Swath width; Incidence angle; AMSR2 Channel Set, 10.65 GHz row
excerpts.text: Scan and rate: Conical scan at 40 rpm. Swath width: Nominal 1450 km, effective 1620 km. The performance guarantee range is +/-61 degrees scanning angle (1450km). The product contains data for a scanning angle of +/-75 degrees (1620km). Incidence angle: Nominal 55 degrees. 10.65 GHz row: beam width 1.2 degrees, ground resolution 24 x 42 km, sampling interval 10 km.
